data.narrative:
Alpine Eagle, a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Jan-Hendrik Boelens and Timo Breuer, has raised €10.25M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic—operating in the same sector and stage proximity.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised as a proxy for current valuation, applies a 2.5x multiplier typical for Seed-to-next-stage advancement, implying $26M. Peer-median analysis across 5 same-sector comparables—Stark Defence ($4.0B, Series A), UFORCE ($1.0B, Seed), Castelion ($1.0B, Series A), Singularity ($400M, Series A), and NODA AI ($125M, Series A)—yields a median valuation of $1.0B, with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $22M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $513M. This wide dispersion reflects fundamental uncertainty around Alpine Eagle's technology maturity, competitive differentiation within a crowded frontier-defense landscape, and the significant stage gap between its Seed status and the Series A–stage majority of comparables. Revenue traction and go-to-market validation will be critical inputs for narrowing this range materially.
